text_en: “Today also my complaint is bitter; his hand is heavy despite my groaning.
text_cn: 直到今天，我还是痛苦的哀诉，他沉重的手掌，使我不得不呻吟。

text_en: Oh, that I knew where I might find him, that I might come even to his dwelling!
text_cn: 惟愿我知道怎样能寻到天主，能到达他的宝座前，

text_en: I would lay my case before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
text_cn: 好将我的案情向他陈诉，因为我口中满了证词！

text_en: I would learn what he would answer me, and understand what he would say to me.
text_cn: 唯愿我知道他答复我的话，明了他向我说什么！

text_en: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No; but he would give heed to me.
text_cn: 他岂能靠强力同我争辩？决不，他必留神听我。

text_en: There an upright person could reason with him, and I should be acquitted forever by my judge.
text_cn: 如此，他会分辨出同他争论的是个正直人，也许我可永久不再受裁判！

text_en: “If I go forward, he is not there; or backward, I cannot perceive him;
text_cn: 可是我往东行，他不在那里；我往西行，也找不到他；

text_en: on the left he hides, and I cannot behold him; I turn to the right, but I cannot see him.
text_cn: 往北找，也看不见他；往南去，也见不到他。

text_en: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I shall come out like gold.
text_cn: 他洞悉我所有的行动。他若试验我，我必如纯金出现。

text_en: My foot has held fast to his steps; I have kept his way and have not turned aside.
text_cn: 我的脚紧随着他的足迹，谨守他的道，总没有偏离。

text_en: I have not departed from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured in my bosom the words of his mouth.
text_cn: 他所发的命令，我总没有违背；他口中的训言，我常保存在心中。

text_en: But he stands alone and who can dissuade him? What he desires, that he does.
text_cn: 但他所决定的，谁能变更？他所乐意的，必要实行。

text_en: For he will complete what he appoints for me; and many such things are in his mind.
text_cn: 他为我注定的，必要完成；类似的事，还有很多。

text_en: Therefore I am terrified at his presence; when I consider, I am in dread of him.
text_cn: 因此，为了他，我很惊慌，一想起来就害怕。

text_en: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me;
text_cn: 天主使我的心沮丧，全能者使我恐怖。

text_en: If only I could vanish in darkness, and thick darkness would cover my face!
text_cn: 因为我虽面临黑暗，幽暗虽遮盖我的面，我仍不丧气。
